articles.title: Benchmark and Regal Ventures buy Forks manufacturing facility, plan 70,000-square-foot expansion
articles.summary: Benchmark Real Estate and Regal Ventures acquired an 85,053-square-foot Forks Township industrial building housing Human Active Technology, with plans for a 70,000-square-foot expansion.

articles.title: JLL Arranges Sale of 365,071 SF Shopping Center in Whitehall, Pennsylvania
articles.summary: WHITEHALL, PA. — JLL has negotiated the sale of Whitehall Plaza, a 365,071-square-foot shopping center located in the Lehigh Valley. Tenants at the open-air center include Floor & Décor, Wawa, The Gravity Vault, Community Bank, Saladworks, Philly Pretzel Factory, Pizza Hut, Health Network Labs, Five Guys and FedEx. articles.title: Food inspection company relocates to the Lehigh Valley
articles.summary: FlexXray has moved its east coast operations to a 26,000-square-foot facility in Upper Macungie Township, Lehigh Valley, creating about 40 jobs.

articles.title: Partnership Underway on 274-Unit Multifamily Project in Horsham, Pennsylvania
articles.summary: HORSHAM, PA. — A partnership between Pennsylvania-based Korman Communities, New York City-based RXR, Japanese asset manager Chuo Nittochi, Goodman Properties and CBG Building Co. is underway on construction of a 274-unit multifamily project in Horsham, a northern suburb of Philadelphia. Known as AVE Horsham, the property will offer studio, one- and two-bedroom units and amenities such as a pool, outdoor grilling and dining stations, coworking space, meeting rooms, game room and a golf simulator.

articles.title: The Post Brothers are planning another large apartment building for Northern Liberties
articles.summary: The developer says apartment demand is still high in Philadelphia's Northern Liberties neighborhood.

articles.title: York receiving $6.7M in state grants for economic, community projects
articles.summary: York County is awarded $6.7 million in Redevelopment Assistance Capital Program grants for economic and community projects across four locations. The post York receiving $6.7M in state grants for economic, community projects appeared first on Central Penn Business Journal .

articles.title: Pa. game wardens need warrants to search posted private property, Supreme Court rules
articles.summary: The state Supreme Court decision affects landowners across Pennsylvania who have posted their property or installed fencing to exclude intruders from their land.

articles.title: How thousands of heavy-duty recycling carts made in Hunting Park ended up on construction sites around the U.S.
articles.summary: Philadelphia's Burns Services invented the TommyCart as a better way to sort, save, and sell recyclable materials from construction sites.

articles.title: Fulton Bank launches banking program for minority and veteran business owners
articles.summary: Lancaster-based Fulton Bank has launched a new banking program aimed at minority, women, veteran and LGBTQ business owners.

articles.title: Tyson Foods launches ride sharing program at its Lancaster County complex
articles.summary: Tyson Foods, just outside New Holland in Earl Township, has launched a ride-share program to address transportation barriers among current workers and attract prospective ones through a partnership with Enterprise, a car rental company.

articles.title: 'It's really all I wanted to do': workers at former R.R. Donnelley plants mourn closure
articles.summary: A Lancaster County man who has worked 30 years in the same printing plant under three different owners tried to fathom what would happen to him after LSC Communications closes that plant in March.

articles.title: Redevelopment of the former St. Joseph Hospital gets $1.5 million grant from the state
articles.summary: A redevelopment project of the former St. Joseph Hospital in Lancaster city was awarded $1.5 million through the state Redevelopment Assistance Capital Program, also known as RACP.
